phase: INS-002A Canonical Contact Attempt and Orchestration Contracts
objective: Define the pure provider-neutral contact-attempt identity, lifecycle, eligibility, idempotency, and provider interface contracts that later INS-002 slices can persist and execute without introducing D1 behavior, routes, provider SDKs, network transport, or production resources.

rules: IDs are non-empty normalized text with the required prefix.
Provider identifiers never replace canonical attempt IDs.
Relationship identity remains canonical RiverCrmRelationshipId.

attemptContract.name: InsuranceContactAttempt
rules: Canonical constructors validate every field.
requestedAt createdAt and updatedAt must be valid timestamps.
Lifecycle timestamps are state-consistent.
Failure fields are allowed only when state is failed.
retryable is allowed only when state is failed.
providerReference requires provider.
No raw provider payload is accepted.
Terminal states cannot transition.
Invalid transitions throw.
Transitions preserve canonical identity and immutable request facts.
Transition helpers set only the lifecycle fields required by the destination state.
A failed attempt is not automatically retried.
Eligibility is provider-neutral and deterministic.
The requested channel must exist.
The requested channel status must be granted.
Channel doNotContact must be false.
Context doNotContact must be false.
Denied revoked unknown or missing consent is ineligible.
Core contracts contain no vendor names.
No transport is executed in INS-002A.
ProviderReference is evidence only.
Structured failures always include retryability.
Keys are non-empty normalized text.
An attempt requires a key before provider transport.
INS-002A defines identity semantics only and performs no persistence or provider request.

tests: Reject failure fields outside failed state.
Reject transitions out of terminal states.
Preserve immutable attempt identity/request fields through transitions.
Eligibility rejects denied revoked and unknown consent.
Provider failure result requires structured code message and retryable.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly four planned INS-002A files are changed.
Eligibility preserves INS-001 consent and suppression semantics.
Attempt lifecycle transitions are explicit and validated.
Idempotency key contract exists before transport.
Repository-wide existing type debt is not broadened into INS-002A.
